mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_notice WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND send_status = 1 AND read_status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_notice ( teacher_id, student_id, course_id, notice_type, absent_count, title, content, send_status, read_status, send_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{teacherId}, #{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{noticeType}, #{absentCount}, #{title}, #{content}, #{sendStatus}, #{readStatus}, #{sendTime}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_notice SET read_status = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND read_status = 0
